newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Bank stocks help Mauritius bourse index edge up.
newsitem.headline: Bank stocks help Mauritius bourse index edge up.

text.p: Gains in the banking sector helped the Mauritius Stock Exchange SEMDEX market index edge up 0.27 points on Monday to 380.83, brokers said.
Turnover rose to 15.70 million rupees on 249,409 shares from 2.50 million rupees on 84,300 shares on Friday.

"Out of the total transaction recorded to-day, Mauritius Commercial Bank accounted for 14.24 million rupees," one broker said. "The situation is alarming, as most of the shares traded were not quoted," another broker said.
Brokers said the quiet market was a result of a shortage of money to invest and political uncertainty.
Mauritius Commercial Bank was 1.50 rupee higher to 90.50 rupees on 157,457 shares and State Bank of Mauritius was unchanged at 12.00 rupees and was not quoted.
All three hotel stocks were stable and unquoted. Sun Resorts unchanged at 50.00 rupees, New Mauritius Hotels at 37.20 rupees and Grand Baie Hotel at 49.00 rupees.
In the commerce sector, conglomerates Ireland Blyth Ltd (IBL) lost 20 cents to 16.00 rupees on 6,550 shares and Rogers remained to 96.00 rupees, but it was unquoted.
Sugar stock Mon Tresor Mon Desert eased 50 cents to 39.50 rupees on 300 shares and Mount lost 30 cents to 20.50 rupees and was unquoted.
In the investment sector National Investment Trust fell 40 cents to 10.00 rupees on 38,100 shares and Policy was stable at 4.05 rupees on 10,000 shares.
Air Mauritius was unchanged at 37.30 rupees on 13,440 shares. ($1=20.93 rupees)
